summary: Invert the kernel modules' upward references (model, client, config, fleet, seat_queue, person_request, conversation_header) and cut the github_admission/resource and native_views/external_sessions cycles; the module allowlist shrinks from 49 to 28 pairs

replay.detail: Definitions move between modules and keep their paths through re-exports. No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, harness, route, CLI output or exit code changes; serialized types keep their fields and serde attributes.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
